events.title: Fed holds rates despite inflation; Bessent open to another hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged despite concerns over inflation, and Treasury Secretary Bessent said it would not necessarily be a mistake if the Fed hiked again. The Fed's stance moves the dollar and global capital flows, so a hawkish tilt weighs on other economies, including Japan, Germany and Canada.
